decisions.summary: Reuse PlatformUser.fullName/avatarUrl as canonical fields and propose a shared Auth/Profile update operation; do not create a parallel profile authority.
Derive user scope from Auth and Billing organization scope from server-verified tenant context; all platforms share semantic operation IDs and errors.
Auth operation support, Billing provider/seller, webhook envelope and provider-specific concurrency/idempotency remain open.

actions: Compared discovery operations with existing AuthPort/PlatformUser, Supabase Auth adapter, Platform Settings and shared API contract patterns.
Defined command/query catalog and proposed DTO semantics for profile, preferences, security and organization billing.
Recorded semantic errors, retryability, pagination, conditional versioning, idempotency and event/reconciliation boundaries.
Specified shared web/native contract behavior and provider-specific open decisions without choosing transport or infrastructure.

validation.evidence: Module run validation passed after Account API checkpoint updates.
All module run checkpoints parsed and validated.

requirements.evidence: api-contracts.md defines queries and commands for profile, preferences, security and organization Billing, with explicit gaps for provider-dependent operations.
api-contracts.md constrains DTO fields, identities, tenant scopes, semantic errors and pagination.
api-contracts.md defines idempotency, version checks, provider reconciliation, events and webhook responsibilities.
Provider capability, billing provider/seller, avatar policy, preferences and transport standards remain open and are assigned to owners.

notes: Current AuthPort includes PlatformUser fields and password update but no profile update, shared Preferences, MFA/session inventory or Billing operations.
No concrete endpoint path or production contract was implemented; the provider-neutral API semantics are design candidates for the approved downstream plan.
No production code, adapter, API DTO, database object, fixture or migration was changed.
